32f9151ef9f4.reason: The lock is taken only after the database query, for in-memory map work that cannot panic (no unwrap or I/O under it), so there is no deadlock or poisoned state. MEMORY is a cache: when the query fails nothing is saved, and the next message falls back to the chat lines, which are the lasting record. It is never meant to survive a restart.
